Description

For Research Use Only. Not for human or veterinary use. Not for use in diagnostic or therapeutic procedures. Not approved by the FDA or any regulatory body for human consumption, treatment, cure, or prevention of any disease.

Semaglutide is a synthetic peptide supplied for in-vitro research into GLP-1 receptor agonism and its downstream effects on metabolic signaling pathways.

In research settings, Semaglutide is studied for its interaction with the GLP-1 receptor, particularly regarding receptor binding affinity, downstream cAMP signaling, and models evaluating incretin-mediated regulation of glucose homeostasis and energy balance.
